b: We have some neighbors whose kids are around the same ages as ours and we have a very active neighborhood with lots of events and so we see them quite often. Lately we’ve been having an issue with their daughter (4.5 years) CONSTANTLY coming up to me to tattle on my daughter who just turned 3 last week.

It’s usually because my daughter won’t share her toys with the friend or my daughter inadvertently “hurt” the friend (I put her in quotations because I’ve watched them interact and it’s never my daughter purposefully hitting or biting It’s literally my daughter standing up when they’re both crouched down and they bonk heads or my daughter spinning around and accidentally hitting the friend in the face with her hand or something).

Now, if I see the incident happen, I usually tell the friend “It looks like that was an accident, [daughter’s name] can you tell her sorry for accidentally hurting her?” But I don’t see every single instance because there’s lots of neighbors and lots of kids and if I’m talking to an adult and she comes up to me screaming bloody murder claiming that my daughter hurt her I kind of don’t know how to handle it because I’ve seen her lie so much? To make matters more awkward it’s usually right in front of the daughter‘s parents and so I feel this pressure to discipline my daughter, even though I truly don’t believe that she did anything.

I see her do this with other kids too. It’s like she just does it to get them in trouble. What’s frustrating is her parents don’t really do anything. If my daughter was going to other parents constantly tattle telling on their kids, I would intervene and tell my daughter if she has any issues to come to me.

I just feel like I’ve been put in this situation so many times over the last couple weeks that I just would like a go-to way to handle it that is fair to my daughter and diplomatic towards my neighbors and their daughter.
